docs.title: AI workflows for investment firms
docs.text: I'm Ruairi Powers. I've spent 25 years building data, trading and research platforms at Bridgewater, Two Sigma and Neudata. This portfolio shows how I design AI workflows for a fund.

docs.title: About
docs.text: Ruairi Powers — technical product and data engineering leader in financial services. Two Sigma: VP, product manager, data engineering. Neudata: SVP, product manager. MIT Applied AI and Data Science.

docs.title: One console for every AI workflow
docs.text: The console shows usage, spend and controls for every AI workflow, and a kill switch the workflows enforce.

docs.title: When something goes wrong: escalation
docs.text: When a rule fires, the console opens an incident, switches the workflow off if severe, and emails the escalation list with a link to the incident.

docs.title: pgvector
docs.text: pgvector adds vector similarity search to Postgres so embeddings live next to the rows they describe.
